data.text/markdown:
Technology Data Input Template

Build a long-format technology dataset (columns: process, technology, parameter, unit, value, reference, note) by entering, editing and exporting technologies one at a time. Workflow
  1. Load an existing CSV (optional) -- must be in this notebook's export format, or it is rejected with a warning.
  2. Review the Calculation variables (constants for formulas).
  3. Choose a technology to edit (optional) -- loads its values into the editor; calculated values come back into the formula field.
  4. Edit the entry fields. Put a literal in value, or an expression in the formula field (e.g. =capacity * 0.95) -- the formula is computed into value, and the note field stays free for human notes.
  5. Save technology to working data -- overwrites that process/technology if it already exists, otherwise appends it.
  6. Edit the meta data.
  7. Export the working data to CSV.
